code:
-- Start GHCi: type ghci at your terminal
-- Every line is an expression; GHCi evaluates and prints it.

Prelude> 3 + 4
7

Prelude> "hello" ++ " " ++ "world"
"hello world"

Prelude> 2 ^ 10
1024

Prelude> True && False
False

Prelude> not True
False
description: You can use GHCi, Haskell's interactive environment, to evaluate expressions.

steps.description: You enter an expression at the Prelude prompt. The next line shows its value.
The ++ operator joins strings. The ^ operator raises a number to a power.
The && operator combines Boolean values with AND. The not function reverses a Boolean value.

title: Expressions in GHCi
